newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX index ends bourse firm but off highs.
newsitem.headline: German DAX index ends bourse firm but off highs.

text.p: The German share market continued its process of recovery on Wednesday after falling ten percent last week, but slipped back over the course of bourse trade, lacking new data to drive the market onwards.

The 30-share DAX index ended at 3,359.46 points, up 29.70 points or 0.89 percent, boosted chiefly by the strength of the dollar at 1.71 marks. Trade was also underpinned by a stronger overnight close on Wall Street.
This was off a session high of 3,378.25 points.
